description: This file defines classes and functions for reading and processing breakpad dump files, specifically for Linux and Android platforms, including symbolization and dump parsing.

classes.name: DumpReaderMultipart
classes.description: Base class for Linux and Android breakpad dump readers, handling dump parsing, symbolization, and dump file processing.

classes.name: DumpReaderLinux
classes.description: Linux-specific implementation of dump reader, providing binaries to symbolize and file extension.

classes.name: DumpReaderAndroid
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of dump reader, providing binaries to symbolize and file extension.

methods.name: check_is_functional
methods.description: Checks if breakpad tools are available.

methods.name: _get_pid_from_dump
methods.description: Extracts process ID from dump file.

methods.name: _get_stack_from_dump
methods.description: Generates and retrieves stack trace from dump file.

methods.name: _read_dump
methods.description: Reads and parses dump file content.

methods.name: _check_breakpad_tools_available
methods.description: Verifies presence of required breakpad tools.

methods.name: _generate_breakpad_symbols_if_necessary
methods.description: Generates breakpad symbols if not already generated.

methods.name: _binaries_to_symbolize
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, returning list of binaries to symbolize.

methods.name: _file_extension
methods.description: Returns file extension for dump files.
